fieldValues.title: B1. Notice
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: something wrong or wanted is written down somewhere durable.

Tried: the Rebel, Watcher and Challenger scouts (SP-01 to SP-47, 10-08); srs-context findings (89); 'file friction as an issue' (clerk ship stage 6.5); the archaeology; Tier-0 vignettes since 10-24.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Trade-off: depth ↔ overload. Practice leans to capturing everything with agents: 202 problem records for 105 SP ids (suggestion plus fork).
- Gone wrong: about 15 merged PRs promised follow-ups never filed (archaeology 1.4); the first real-use session left no record and srs-web#587-590 sat unlabelled (audit); plan files are local and untracked (clerk#8); feedback outruns reading (SP-12).
